meta.title: W2M: AI Agent Fleet!
meta.description:
W2M is an open-source (MIT) AI agent fleet orchestrator. With one DeepSeek, Doubao or WorkBuddy account, it turns your own machines (Windows/Mac) into a fleet for unified command dispatch, collaboration and joint development.
Three components: Relay (HTTP+SSE coordination server), Agent (runs on each machine, executes allow-listed commands) and Plugin (18 tools for the agent).
